name: Equestrian facility
summary: Boarding/training facility with a stall barn, covered riding arena, outdoor arena, paddocks/fencing and site work, priced per stall. The barn (~300 SF per stall incl. aisles, tack, feed and wash) and the covered arena (a fixed ~20,000 SF clear-span structure spread over the stall count) are each roughly a third of cost, so per-stall cost falls as stall count rises. ALL VALUES ARE DERIVED: no fetchable authoritative source was found this session (cost-guide sites returned 403 and the web search budget was exhausted). Verify with a barn builder/arena quote.

typicalSize.method: Judgment: small private/boarding barn 10 stalls; typical commercial boarding/training facility 30 stalls; large show/training center 100+.

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Roofed area per stall: barn ≈ 250–350 SF/stall (12×12 stall + share of 12–14 ft aisle, tack, feed, wash, office) plus a 100×200 ft (20,000 SF) covered arena ÷ 30 stalls ≈ 667 SF → ~950 SF. Low = barn only (no covered arena); high = 400 SF barn + 1,000 SF arena share (smaller facility or larger arena).

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Boarding facilities with daily turnout need ~1 acre or more of paddock/pasture per horse; dry-lot/show facilities pack 2–3 stalls per gross acre.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Boarder, staff and trailer parking (gravel); show facilities need far more event/trailer parking (high).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Build-up per stall at a 30-stall facility (2026$): barn 300 SF × $85/SF = $25.5k (pre-engineered/post-frame building in the shared PEMB block range $70–160/SF, toward the low end because stalls are unconditioned, plus stall fronts/partitions and waterers); covered arena 20,000 SF × $35/SF (open-sided clear-span steel incl. lighting and arena base/footing) = $700k ÷ 30 = $23.3k; paddock/perimeter board or vinyl fencing ≈ $8k/stall; site work (grading, gravel drives and trailer parking, water/electric distribution, manure pad, stormwater) ≈ $12k/stall. Total ≈ $68.8k → $70k. Low $35k = barn at ~$60/SF × 250 SF + fencing + site, no covered arena. High $160k = premium barn (~$150/SF × 400 SF), enclosed/insulated arena share ~$50k, larger site and fencing. All assumptions — verify. | Second pass (2026-10-24): Arena component now has low-confidence sourced brackets (p2 evidence); barn per-stall remains a build-up — verify with local barn-builder quotes.

perSF.method: perPrimaryUnit ÷ sfPerPrimaryUnit (roofed barn + arena share): mid $70k ÷ 950 SF ≈ $74/SF; low/high bracket open-sided vs enclosed construction (not a simple ratio of the stall range because the low stall case has no arena).

scope.notes: Stall barn, covered arena with footing, outdoor arena/paddocks, fencing, on-site utilities and drives, GC/OH&P. Excludes land, well/septic where no utilities (optional line), off-site road/utility work, horse equipment (hot walker, jumps), soft costs.

qualityTiers.method: Economy ≈ pole barn with outdoor arena only; premium ≈ steel barn with enclosed arena; luxury ≈ high/mid ($160k/$70k) show-quality facility.

systemSplit.method: From the mid build-up: steel/post frame of barn and arena (05) 0.20; roofing/siding (07) 0.10; slab, aisles, wash rack and footings (03) 0.08; stall fronts/wood linings (06) 0.06; doors (08) 0.03; specialties (10) 0.02; stall equipment/waterers (11) 0.04; plumbing/hydrants (22) 0.04; fans/ventilation (23) 0.02; electrical/lighting (26) 0.06; grading and arena base (31) 0.10; footing, fencing, gravel drives/parking (32) 0.14; site utilities (33) 0.03; general conditions (01) 0.08. Judgment — verify.

cost.method: 250–400 SF per stall × $60–150/SF (shared pre-engineered metal building block $70–160/SF as anchor, lower end for unconditioned post-frame barns). Verify.

lineItems.name: Paddock / perimeter fencing (board, vinyl or no-climb wire)

cost.method: Assumption: ≈ 400 LF of fence per stall (individual/group paddocks + perimeter) at $10–35/LF installed. Verify.

lineItems.name: Water well and septic system (rural sites without utilities)

cost.method: Assumption: agricultural well + pump + small commercial septic for barn restroom/wash. Verify locally.

lineItems.name: Manure storage pad / bunker with runoff control

cost.method: Assumption: concrete pad with push walls, sized ~1–2 SF per stall-day of storage. Verify.

lineItems.notes: Inside the site-work allowance of the baseline; often required by state nutrient-management rules.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Tack lockers, feed/hay equipment, jumps/arena equipment, hot walker, office/lounge furniture spread per stall. Assumption — verify.

pctOfHard.method: Agricultural buildings are often permit-exempt or lightly regulated and use builder-engineered packages; mid 10% covers civil engineering, structural stamps, permits, surveys and PM. Higher for public/commercial show facilities.

perPrimaryUnit.method: All-in hard + soft: from a basic pole barn with paddocks (~$25k/stall) to a show-quality facility with enclosed arena (~$250k/stall). Derived.
